role: The snapshot of nearby chunks a WorldRenderer meshes from (and pathfinding reads): block, meta, tile entity and light reads with the neighbour-max light rule for stairs, slabs and farmland.

members.name: chunkX/chunkZ
members.note: the window's origin; its margin covers every cell a mesh reads

members.name: chunkArray
members.note: the window's chunk records (play.c rw_take: the live chunk's bands shared)

members.name: isEmpty
members.note: only WorldRenderer's skip of an all-empty cache: meshing empty sections draws nothing

members.name: ChunkCache
members.note: the live window over the client's chunks (scene dumps load it with rb_world_load)

members.name: extendedLevelsInChunkCache
members.note: isEmpty's getter, the same render skip

members.name: getTileEntity
members.note: the live world's tile entity (the flower pot's plant), a scene's tileentities.bin list

members.name: isAirBlock
members.note: only RenderBlocks.renderBlockPane asks it, for a pane's top and bottom edges; cr-sweep-gold-g27 to g29-s42's frames draw panes (a frame replay: lane/covframes' coverage of the frame recordings)

members.name: getSkyBlockTypeBrightness
members.note: 0 for sky under hasNoSky (rb_world no_sky), y clamped to 0..255, the neighbour maximum for func_149710_n blocks; the 30,000,000 bound is outside any reachable world

members.name: getSpecialBlockBrightness
members.note: its callers clamp y first, so saved_light's y < 0 answer is never reached from ChunkCache

notes: render_blocks3.c:is_air is a static helper. The chunk-load bound behaviour (absent chunk reads 0) matches Java's null-chunk air for getBlock. Verification only (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): verification only: the member is ported but no scene pins it; covered by the verify list, not a port (Nether sky brightness through the dump's zero sky array). It stays partial until a recording pins it. Closed by lane/idxworld: the live renderer's cache is the rb_world window around the camera (every cell a section mesh reads, one past its edges), its tile entities the live world's (a flower pot's plant: out/java/clientframes/idx-pot-s1, where master drew the pots empty), and its sky brightness 0 under a hasNoSky provider before any chunk read, as ChunkCache.getSkyBlockTypeBrightness answers (rw_build's memset had wiped both fields). The pathfinder's ChunkCache reads the live world in pathfind.c: its box covers the search's reach, so no read falls outside it, and the chunks its construction loads are the world's own loads (serverreplay.c reseeds World.rand for them); test_paths holds the paths.
